Episode pages are finalized as soon as a private YouTube upload returns its stable video ID. Rights, medical-QA, and caption checks must pass before upload; public visibility remains a separate owner action. No commercial question-bank or recall content is reproduced.

## Use

- This material is for exam preparation and general medical education.
- It is not medical advice, a diagnosis, or a substitute for care from a licensed clinician.
